| Master's Student, Department of Civil Engineering, Graduate School of Engineering, The University of Tokyo
| [Lab for Innovative Infrastructure Systems (LIIS, Fukuda Laboratory)](https://liis.t.u-tokyo.ac.jp/en/)
| Student, [WINGS-GLAFS](http://www.glafs.u-tokyo.ac.jp/)

**Research Interests:** Transportation Economics, Spatial Economics, Welfare Analysis\
**Memberships:** Japan Society of Civil Engineers (JSCE), Applied Regional Science Conference (ARSC)

## Research

- Restructuring of transport networks in aging and depopulating regions
- Long-run effects of high-speed rail on interregional migration and welfare
- Benefit evaluation of transport infrastructure using dynamic spatial economic models
